dedupe_keys.name: innovapower three phase pmsg short circuit signals

description: InnovaPower at the University of São Paulo publishes laboratory measurements from a permanent-magnet synchronous generator under healthy and short-circuit conditions. Its PMSG-3phase-Dataset is named separately from the parent repository’s conventional synchronous- and induction-generator collections. The inspected directory contains 225 MATLAB measurement files and supporting Python visualization code. Filenames distinguish winding faults, three rotor speeds and three torque settings. The parent documentation identifies currents, voltages, fault current, speed, torque and converter-control variables as measurement classes. Access is free under CC BY 4.0, with the PMSG release archived on Zenodo. Geographic coverage is one controlled test bench; a field observation period and sampling interval were not established from the root repository documentation. The cases deliberately induce faults, so their relative frequencies do not estimate operational failure probabilities. A reviewer-assessed use is validating generator-condition components before applying failure scenarios in simulations with model-pandapower. No measurements or executable files were downloaded.
